question: What is the race of the superhero with maximum attribute value?
evidence: maximum attribute value refers to MAX(attribute_value);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T3.race AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC) AS __r FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T3.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: Return the race of every superhero whose attribute value in hero_attribute equals the overall maximum attribute_value, including all superheroes tied at that maximum
b.sql: SELECT r.race FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)

d.request: What is the race of the superhero (or superheroes) with the maximum attribute value (MAX(attribute_value)), returning all superheroes whose attribute value ties for that maximum?
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.superhero_name, r.race FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id LEFT JOIN race r ON r.id = s.race_id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)

c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.race FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)
